# DevTrack

> DevTrack is a free, open-source web app that turns a developer's GitHub activity into stats, streaks and a global ranking. Developers sign in with GitHub to see their commits, pull requests, contribution streak and languages, set coding goals, and compare themselves with friends and other developers worldwide.

DevTrack is built with Next.js and is developed in the open on GitHub, where contributors of every experience level are welcome.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://devtrack.live/): what DevTrack is and live stats for the project itself
- [Global leaderboard](https://devtrack.live/leaderboard): developers with public profiles ranked by coding streak, commits and merged pull requests, filterable by language and period (week, month, all time)
- [Public profiles](https://devtrack.live/u/{github-username}): a developer's streak, contributions, top languages, pull requests and GitHub achievements. Only shown for users who made their profile public.
- [Year in Code](https://devtrack.live/wrapped): a yearly recap of a developer's GitHub activity

## How rankings work

- Only developers who opt in to a public profile appear on the leaderboard.
- Rankings are computed from public GitHub activity: current contribution streak, commits and pull requests in the selected period.
- Data refreshes about hourly.

## Guides

- [Add GitHub stats to your profile README](https://devtrack.live/guides/github-stats-readme): live rank, streak and monthly commit badges, with copy-paste Markdown.
- [GitHub streaks](https://devtrack.live/guides/github-streak): GitHub removed streak counters in 2016; how streaks are counted now and how to keep one.
- [Compare two GitHub profiles](https://devtrack.live/guides/compare-github-profiles): side-by-side duels on streaks, contributions, commits, PRs and reviews.
- [How the DevTrack score works](https://devtrack.live/guides/devtrack-score): the 0-1000 score, six tiers, XP and levels.

## Top developers

- [By language](https://devtrack.live/top): the most-followed GitHub developers for 20 languages, updated daily.
- [By country](https://devtrack.live/top/country/india): the most-followed GitHub developers in 28 countries, e.g. India, the United States, Germany, Brazil.
